# Thomas Breindl

> Portfolio of a software developer and designer in Passau, Germany.

## When to use this site

Use this site to:

- assess Thomas for Java, TypeScript, backend, full-stack, legacy-modernization, event-pipeline, performance, observability, infrastructure, or interface work
- check his experience, projects, stack, location, and public profiles
- find contact and privacy information for thomasbreindl.me

Do not infer availability or experience that is not stated here.

## How agents should use it

Request a page with `Accept: text/markdown` for Markdown. To contact Thomas, email `contact@thomasbreindl.me` with the problem, relevant technical context, and timing. Do not include credentials or private production data.

- [Portfolio](https://thomasbreindl.me/index.md): experience, stack, and selected work
